name: Holand og Setskog Sparebank
summary: Høland og Setskog Sparebank, a savings bank, provides banking products and services to individuals and business clients. The company offers various accounts, loans, mortgages, financing, fund savings and pension products, banking and cards, online banking, mobile banking and payment services, payment terminal and OTP services, and guarantees, as well as insurance and leasing services. It operates through offices in Bjørkelangen, Setskog, Hemnes, and Løken in Aurskog-Holand municipality, Norway. The company was formerly known as Holand Sparebank and changed its name to Høland og Setskog Sparebank in 2010. Høland og Setskog Sparebank was founded in 1849 and is based in Bjørkelangen, Norway.
